evidence: Homepage lists 8 heritage cards; count label reads "共 8 个非遗项目" matching the 8 rendered cards (春节, 端午龙舟, 剪纸, 京剧, 昆曲, 书法, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂).
Clicking the 苏绣/京剧 hotspots in the panorama opened an overlay with title, category badge, region, images, brief description, and a "查看详情" link to the detail page.
/heritage/peking-opera shows title 京剧, English subtitle, category 传统表演, region 北京·京城古韵, inclusion year 2010年入选, full multi-sentence introduction, and a gallery with 3 thumbnails.
Category filter "传统工艺" reduced list to 2 items with count "共 2 个非遗项目"; sort dropdown offers 按名称/按年份/按地区 and applies without error; search "剪纸" reduced list to 1 matching item with count "共 1 个非遗项目".

Before navigating to detail page, panorama transform was "scale(0.8) rotateX(3.6deg) translateX(-60px)" with hotspots 京剧/端午龙舟/宜兴紫砂/春节 and 京剧 overlay open; after returning via "返回全景探索", transform and hotspot set were identical and the 京剧 overlay was still open.
All 8 homepage cards carry one of exactly 4 category badges: 民俗活动 (Folk Activities), 传统美术 (Traditional Art), 传统表演 (Performing Arts), 传统工艺 (Traditional Crafts).

Valid link /heritage/peking-opera opened the matching 京剧 item; invalid link /heritage/nonexistent-item-xyz showed "未找到该非遗项目" with a "返回首页" link back to the homepage, with no unrelated project details shown.
Each homepage card (e.g. 苏绣) displays title, English subtitle, category badge (传统工艺), region (江苏·江南水乡), and a brief description paragraph.
Clicking "浏览更多项目" on the 苏绣 detail page navigated to http://localhost:6063/#categories, landing back on the homepage's 非遗项目 list section.

A real Playwright drag on the panorama drag-layer changed the scene transform (rotateX/translateX), and clicking the zoom-out control changed scale from 1 to 0.8; hotspot count remained 4 (not lost) throughout dragging and zooming, and hotspot identities cycled while panning, indicating continued interactivity.

On /heritage/paper-cutting, thumbnail 1's image intentionally failed to load and the page showed explicit failure text "图片加载失败"; selecting thumbnail 2 replaced it with a working main image (alt="剪纸 - 2", valid src), confirming both success and failure states are handled.
With category=传统工艺, sort=按年份 applied (count "共 2 个非遗项目"), navigating into 苏绣 detail page and back via "浏览更多项目" preserved the same filter/sort selections and 2-item result count.
Gallery/thumbnail images use alt text bound to the item name (e.g. "京剧 - 2", "剪纸 thumbnail 2", "苏绣 1/2/3") with distinct image URLs per item, consistent with each item's name/category.
